callouts.text: 1 · Select Code, then use the </> Language menu. Choose a mode and confirm the same dark product surface closes cleanly.
2 · Use T for the text-size list and the numbered-lines icon beside it. Both are Code-only controls with matching compact chrome.
3 · Open the ruler Width menu. Snap to Compact / Standard / Wide / Extra wide, or enter 72ch in Custom; then drag the lower-right handle for a free width.
PASS WHEN · Language, type size, lines, and character width all feel like one selected-object ribbon in Light and Dark; Width supports presets, custom ch, and free resize.
